reason: Critical issues remain (broken network preferential attachment, counterfactuals mutating main state, parameter mismatch, performance hotspot) and major spec gaps (epidemic dynamics, locations, enforcement, mask types/efficacy, required metrics). With two iterations left, we can still make significant progress by fixing logic/consistency bugs and adding a minimal epidemic/location/enforcement layer to satisfy core metrics.

specific_areas: Fix scale_free_graph degree updates and total-degree accounting to restore proper preferential attachment.
Refactor compute_policy_impact to run on cloned Simulation instances; remove any mutation of the main simulation.
Standardize parameter naming to misinformation_rate and use media.misinformation_rate within belief updates; keep backward-compatible alias.
Incorporate social_influence_weight explicitly into the adoption decision equation.
Optimize SES quantile computation to O(N log N) and cast ses_quantile to int.
Add information_reach to summary metrics and wrap remaining file writes in try/except.
Implement a minimal EpidemicEnvironment (SIR-lite) to produce daily_infection_incidence, cumulative_infections, and Rt.
Introduce a basic Location system (home, work/school, retail) with movement schedule, ventilation factor, and simple mask policy flag.
Add mask types (cloth, surgical, respirator) with simple efficacy parameters; track mask_quality_mix and retailer inventory_by_type/price_by_type.
Implement simple enforcement (inspection probability, warnings/fines) to compute policy_compliance_rate and enforcement_actions_count.
Ensure calibration and counterfactual routines use separate simulator instances and non-trivial targets.

task_understanding.adjustments: Re-anchor on the full spec: epidemic dynamics, locations/movement, mask types/efficacy, enforcement/subsidies, and required metrics (incidence, cumulative infections, Rt, compliance, enforcement actions, quality mix).

data_analysis.adjustments: Tie risk perception to reported incidence/Rt (with lag) and media exposure; prepare or synthesize non-trivial calibration targets; validate Rt and incidence plausibility.

model_planning.adjustments: Define a minimal viable epidemic and location/enforcement design that can be implemented within one iteration: SIR-lite with per-contact transmission at locations; simple daily schedule; mask efficacy and ventilation modifiers.

code_generation.adjustments: Prioritize fixes for logic and performance (network, SES ranking); implement minimal modules with clean interfaces, docstrings, and deterministic behavior; avoid O(N^2) patterns.

code_verification.adjustments: Add unit-style checks: degree sum equals 2E after network build; counterfactuals do not mutate main state; metrics keys present; quick sanity tests for Rt and incidence series.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Ensure separate RNG seeds/instances for counterfactuals; respect reproducibility via ParameterManager; bound horizon for quick tests while enabling full runs.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute and validate all required metrics (including information_reach); check for NaNs/infs; ensure time_to_target_adoption and policy impact are meaningful and stable.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide a concise change log, limitations of the minimal epidemic module, and next steps; explicitly list which spec metrics are now satisfied.
